more_info.overview: Mannitol is used as a stabilizer in food. Its technological role is to help maintain the structure of food.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include foods for infants and young children. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Specified mannitol can be made by hydrogenating glucose- or fructose-containing solutions, or by fermentation with a suitable Zygosaccharomyces rouxii yeast strain.
